import math
# Per-seed acceptance rate (joint-pass unique / total evals)
rates = [(123/3744), (7/2016), (2/1344)]
mean = sum(rates) / len(rates)
# Sample std (n-1)
var = sum((r - mean)**2 for r in rates) / (len(rates) - 1)
sd = math.sqrt(var)
se = sd / math.sqrt(len(rates))
print(f'rates (as %): {[r*100 for r in rates]}')
print(f'mean (%): {mean*100:.4f}')
print(f'SD  (%): {sd*100:.4f}')
print(f'SE  (%): {se*100:.4f}')
print(f'95% CI: ({(mean - 1.96*se)*100:.4f}, {(mean + 1.96*se)*100:.4f}) %')
print(f'Hay 2011 baseline 0.40%, Druckmann 2007 baseline 0.10%')
print(f'Mean is between/within Hay-Druckmann envelope? Hay=0.40% Druckmann=0.10% Mean={mean*100:.4f}%')
